hook.name: VolcanoHook
hook.description: Tracks buy/sell swaps on a designated volcano token pool: buys increment "volcano energy" (+1% per transaction) and sells mark the seller as "ashed" (ineligible for rewards). When energy reaches 100% an "eruption" occurs, distributing the accumulated ETH reward pool proportionally to non-ashed token holders, then resetting energy and the round.
